Hello!

As many of you know, we're in the middle of the great Reddit migration of 2015. Many users are flooding voat with new accounts, and trying to get a feel for how voat's community works.

I'm making a tool that will aid in that process. Basically, if you have a reddit account with a bunch of subreddit subscriptions, my script will try and find corresponding subverses and subscribe you to them. The big issue is that not every subverse is named exactly the same as it's reddit counterpart. Here's where you come in. I made a google for that you can fill out linking a subreddit to it's corresponding subverse. After a pair has gained a certain number of submissions, my script will begin associating that link between voat and reddit.

You don't have to be the owner of the subreddit or the subverse in order to submit: just think of some good pairings on your own and submit them.

If everything works out as planned, this tool will make the transition from reddit to voat as seamless as ever, and help our community grow.

Here is the Google Form: http://goo.gl/forms/C7QPwKOiTU

I'm still working on the script but I'll get a GitHub repo set up ASAP so people can start contributing. Please feel free to message me if you have any questions, comments, or feedback about this project. It's still in it's formative stage so feedback is very much appreciated!

EDIT: I've created the GitHub repo here: https://github.com/samclane/VRI

By the time you see this I doubt anything substantial will be added but feel free to contribute.
